Reviewer reported PASS after reviewing the temporarily-unavailable/degraded condition for truthful degradation, preserved task state, usability, and absence of automatic fallback or navigation.
Reviewer reported PASS with Reduced Motion selected after checking that the page remained understandable and usable without essential meaning depending on motion.
